about.title: About Us
about.text: BuildLabs Pakistan is a team of engineers on a mission to change how the next generation experiences science and technology. We travel to schools and colleges across Pakistan, turning ordinary classrooms into hands-on engineering labs bring real skills, real tools, and real challenges to students who are ready for more than just a textbook.

cta.title: Bring a workshop to your school or campus
cta.text: Get in touch and we will plan it together.

team.name: Emaan Noor
team.message: I started BuildLabs with one belief that every student in Pakistan deserves access to hands-on engineering education. We are just getting started, and the best is yet to come.

team.name: Ayesha Shaheen
team.message: Behind every smooth workshop is a hundred moving parts. My job is to make sure none of them show so students walk in and just experience the magic.

team.name: Naurish Fatima
team.message: Good ideas need solid foundations. I make sure our resources are managed responsibly so BuildLabs can keep growing and reaching more students across Pakistan.

team.name: Sameen Anjum
team.message: Every component in a workshop kit has a story, I make sure it arrives on time, at the right cost, and ready to build something remarkable.

team.name: Ayesha Noor
team.message: Connecting with schools and institutions is what drives me. Every partnership we build is another door we open for students who have never had access to this kind of learning.
